title: Associativity and pushout description of Yoneda Ext composition
statement: For a scheme $X$, with $\operatorname{Ext}_X$ as in [def-sc-ext-sheaf], Yoneda composition of extension classes is associative. If $0\to\mathcal A\to\mathcal B\to\mathcal C\to0$ represents $\delta\in\operatorname{Ext}^1_X(\mathcal C,\mathcal A)$ and $\varphi:\mathcal A\to\mathcal W$, then the Ext connecting map defined by pushing out this short exact sequence along $\varphi$ is the class $\varphi[1]\circ\delta\in\operatorname{Ext}^1_X(\mathcal C,\mathcal W)$; consequently $(\varphi[1]\circ\delta)\circ s=\varphi[1]\circ(\delta\circ s)$ for every $s:\mathcal O_X\to\mathcal C$.

source.place: Homology Section Tag 010I (extensions, Baer pushout) and Derived Section Tag 06XP (bilinear associative composition of Ext groups)

proof.text: Represent each Ext class by a composable extension (or by the corresponding derived-category morphism). The Yoneda splice of three extensions is independent of whether the first two or the last two are spliced first, giving $(g\circ f)\circ e=g\circ(f\circ e)$.

source.place: Derived Section Tag 06XP, associative composition of Ext groups

proof.text: The pushout of the short exact sequence along $\varphi$ is the coefficient-change image of its extension class. Thus the pushed-out sequence represents $\varphi[1]\circ\delta$.

source.place: Homology Section Tag 010I, pushout of extensions

proof.text: Applying the associativity identity to $e=s$, $f=\delta$, and $g=\varphi[1]$ gives $(\varphi[1]\circ\delta)\circ s=\varphi[1]\circ(\delta\circ s)$.

lean.statement: theorem ext_yoneda_assoc_pushout {X : Scheme.{u}} [HasExt.{u} X.Modules] : (∀ {A B C D : X.Modules} {i j k ij jk n : ℕ} (e : Ext A B i) (f : Ext B C j) (g : Ext C D k) (hij : i + j = ij) (hjk : j + k = jk) (h : i + j + k = n), (e.comp f hij).comp g (show ij + k = n by omega) = e.comp (f.comp g hjk) (show i + jk = n by omega)) ∧ (∀ (S : ShortComplex X.Modules) (hS : S.ShortExact) {W : X.Modules} (φ : S.X₁ ⟶ W), ∃ hT : (ShortComplex.mk (pushout.inr S.f φ) (pushout.desc S.g 0 (by rw [S.zero, comp_zero])) (pushout.inr_desc _ _ _)).ShortExact, (hT.extClass : Ext S.X₃ W 1) = (hS.extClass : Ext S.X₃ S.X₁ 1).comp (Abelian.Ext.mk₀ φ : Ext S.X₁ W 0) (add_zero 1)) ∧ (∀ (S : ShortComplex X.Modules) (hS : S.ShortExact) {W : X.Modules} (φ : S.X₁ ⟶ W) (s : SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf ⟶ S.X₃), let δ : Ext S.X₃ S.X₁ 1 := hS.extClass let φ₀ : Ext S.X₁ W 0 := Abelian.Ext.mk₀ φ let s₀ : Ext (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf) S.X₃ 0 := Abelian.Ext.mk₀ s s₀.comp (δ.comp φ₀ (add_zero 1)) (zero_add 1) = (s₀.comp δ (zero_add 1)).comp φ₀ (add_zero 1))
